original_quote: We rejuvenated five lakes in Bengaluru, enhancing the water holding capacity by about 5 billion liters compared to the baseline before rejuvenation.
Consequently, our total municipal water withdrawal decreased from 2.5 million kiloliters in FY23 to 2.1 million kiloliters in FY24, representing a 16% reduction year-over-year.
Through aggressive retrofitting across our tier-2 city campuses, we replaced direct FCU units with chilled water units of air conditioning, which saved 1.1 lakh kWh of electricity.
Furthermore, the implementation of our new radiant cooling system—which is about 50% more efficient than regular air-conditioning—contributed to massive campus-wide savings.
Due to these combined efforts, we successfully reduced our scope 1 and 2 emissions by 60.07% over the BAU (Business As Usual) scenario.
The retrofit project alone reduced our absolute emissions by 80.84 tCO2e compared to before the retrofit.
We successfully recycled 99.5% of all e-waste generated, up from 94% in the previous reporting period.
